Class JULBridge

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.jul.JULBridge
public final class JULBridge extends Object
Translates java.util.logging.LogRecord into Rainbow Gum LogEvent and routes it through LogRouter.global(). Shared by two independent JUL integration strategies: this module's own Handler-based bridge (SystemLoggerQueueJULHandler, installed on the default JUL root logger), and the separate rainbowgum-jul-logmanager module's java.util.logging.LogManager replacement (which routes every java.util.logging.Logger call directly, bypassing JUL's normal Handler/Level dispatch entirely). Kept here, exported, so neither integration duplicates the level mapping or event construction.

    • isLoggable

      public static boolean isLoggable(String loggerName, Level level)
      Whether a logger name at a given JUL level is currently enabled, per Rainbow Gum's own level resolution rather than anything cached on a JUL Logger/Handler.
      Parameters:
      loggerName - logger name, as JUL would pass to Logger.getName().
      level - JUL level being checked.
      Returns:
      true if a record at this name/level would actually be routed.

    • publish

      public static void publish(@Nullable LogRecord rec)
      Translates a JUL LogRecord into a Rainbow Gum event and routes it, if the record's logger name/level is currently enabled. A null record or a record with a null logger name is silently ignored, matching Handler.publish(LogRecord)'s own contract for null.
      Parameters:
      rec - JUL log record, possibly null.
